description: This file defines an Android Fragment named OrdersFragment that displays a list of previous orders, including their IDs, totals, statuses, and placement times. It manages a ListView with a custom adapter to populate the order information dynamically.

classes.name: OrdersFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays a list of previous orders with their details, using a custom adapter.

classes.name: OrdersAdapter
classes.description: An inner class within OrdersFragment that adapts Order data for display in a ListView.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout, initializes ListView and adapter, and populates the list with orders.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the list of orders from repository and updates the adapter; toggles visibility of empty view.

methods.name: setItems
methods.description: Sets new list of orders and refreshes the ListView display.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of Order items.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the Order object at a specified position.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the ID for the item, here simply the position as Long.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or updates a View for a specific order, populating order ID, total, status, and time.
